items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: John Bonplay, Dave Chicago. I used to play with him. He used to play with him on Franklin Street, too.

ctx.x: Which one was called Papa Teo?

The oldest one, Lorenzo. He was a cigar maker. Yeah, he was a cigar maker. Papa Teo was Lorenzo Junior's uncle. That's right. That's correct. Under the whole family. Did you know them all? Sure. Who was the best musician in the family? Well, I'm going to tell you, the old man was supposed to be the best. Old man to you. Louis. Yes. I'm telling you. Who was the best man for playing by ear? Lorenzo. Papa, be careful. Who's Lorenzo Junior or the other one? I mean, the old man, the T. or Louis. He play, but he don't…
Who were some of the other good trombone players in the old days?
